title: A regulatory network of Sox and Six transcription factors initiate a cell fate transformation during hearing regeneration in adult zebrafish.
authors: Jimenez, Erin; Slevin, Claire C; Song, Wei; Chen, Zelin; Frederickson, Stephen C; Gildea, Derek; Wu, Weiwei; Elkahloun, Abdel G; Ovcharenko, Ivan; Burgess, Shawn M
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单细胞表观基因组和转录组及深度学习识别再生过程中TF基序，但核心是细胞命运转变的调控网络，缺乏TF-DNA三维互作建模或结合机制研究，仅部分涉及蛋白-DNA互作。
abstract: Using adult zebrafish inner ears as a model for sensorineural regeneration, we ablated the mechanosensory receptors and characterized the single-cell epigenome and transcriptome at consecutive time points during hair cell regeneration. We utilized deep learning on the regeneration-induced open chromatin sequences and identified cell-specific transcription factor (TF) motif patterns. Enhancer activity correlated with gene expression and identified potential gene regulatory networks. A pattern of overlapping Sox- and Six-family TF gene expression and binding motifs was detected, suggesting a combinatorial program of TFs driving regeneration and cell identity. Pseudotime analysis of single-cell transcriptomic data suggested that support cells within the sensory epithelium changed cell identity to a "progenitor" cell population that could differentiate into hair cells. We identified a 2.6 kb DNA enhancer upstream of the sox2 promoter that, when deleted, showed a dominant phenotype that resulted in a hair-cell-regeneration-specific deficit in both the lateral line and adult inner ear.
abstract_zh: 以成年斑马鱼内耳作为感觉神经再生的模型，我们消融了机械感觉受体，并在毛细胞再生的连续时间点表征了单细胞表观基因组和转录组。我们利用深度学习对再生诱导的开放染色质序列进行分析，识别出细胞特异性转录因子（TF）基序模式。增强子活性与基因表达相关，并揭示了潜在的基因调控网络。检测到Sox和Six家族转录因子基因表达及结合基序的重叠模式，表明存在一个驱动再生和细胞身份的转录因子组合程序。单细胞转录组数据的伪时间分析提示，感觉上皮内的支持细胞改变细胞身份，转变为可分化成毛细胞的“祖细胞”群体。我们鉴定了sox2启动子上游一个2.6 kb的DNA增强子，其缺失时表现出显性表型，导致侧线和成年内耳中毛细胞再生特异性缺陷。
